source.label: SeaWaves: HMS Chiddingfold arrival at Portsmouth

rationale: Corrected the older Bahrain marker to the newer historical Portsmouth report: SeaWaves records HMS Chiddingfold at Portsmouth on 5 April 2025; Solent Maritime Society reports tugs returning the minehunter to her base that day; later Southend Master Mariners reporting says she arrived at Portsmouth in April 2025 and entered extended readiness. The coordinate is a representative HMNB Portsmouth base marker, not an observed berth or current position. Operational status remains Unknown.

source.label: Forces News: HMS Middleton enters Falmouth dry dock

rationale: Superseded the older 2 June UK patrol-circuit marker with the later Falmouth dry-dock report. Forces News reports on 26 June 2026 that HMS Middleton entered dry dock for Re-Certification Docking at Balaena Falmouth; the Royal Navy's 17 June report identifies Falmouth as her next stop to begin Re-Certification Docking; the official vessel X profile at https://x.com/HMSMiddleton corroborates the account identity, but no recoverable individual status URL was available and none is asserted. Balaena is attributed to the secondary report. The rounded yard marker is independently based on Balaena's official identification of its Falmouth shipyard, Falmouth's official listing of the facility at The Docks, TR11 4NR, and the OpenStreetMap industrial footprint for the former A&P Falmouth site; it is representative, not an exact dry dock, berth or current position. Operational status remains In re-fit.
